WITH active_devices AS (
                SELECT
                    MIN(last_synced_seq) AS seq
                FROM
                    device_sync_watermarks
                WHERE
                    user_id = ?1 AND
                    namespace = ?2 AND
                    is_revoked = 0 AND
                    last_seen_at >= ?3
            ),
            latest_snapshot AS (
                SELECT
                    MAX(snapshot_seq) AS seq
                FROM
                    ledger_snapshots
                WHERE
                    user_id = ?1 AND
                    namespace = ?2
            )
            SELECT
                active_devices.seq AS min_device_seq,
                latest_snapshot.seq AS max_snapshot_seq
            FROM
                active_devices,
                latest_snapshot
